integrity: The proof is analytic; exact-rational enumerations are supporting finite checks only. All source attribution is to cited public literature.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-point classification applies only to invariant face w=0. The published parameter range is K<=255.936; the K-to-infinity law explicitly extends the formula beyond it. One-sided branch multipliers do not establish smoothness across modulo jumps or stability of interior typical orbits. No cryptographic-security claim or independent publication-priority validation.
title: A quadratic fixed-point staircase and universal boundary distribution in a three-dimensional modular logistic map
